title: LLM inserting elements into the world - demo
author: levmiseri
selftext: I put together a small demo where players can insert \*anything\* into the world via an LLM. I'm curious what people think about a concept like this?

comments.author: AxiosXiphos
comments.body: Whoa! Feels like we are finally getting interesting A.I. concepts. Is there a game attached or is it more of a sandbox

comments.author: radgh
comments.body: This is pretty cool! Portals worked. A lot of stuff can't be created. I created a fire sword since pvp is obviously part of the game but couldn't figure out how to attack. Maybe need a way to use items? I created a staff that I could cast that seemed to work but idk if it actually does anything besides make pink particles. I created spongebob squirepants and he followed me around saying "I am ready!", that was funny

comments.author: Cristazio
comments.body: Honestly if an LLM was able to create actual ASCII art an drop it live in a game it would make a banger multiplayer sandbox game

comments.author: Low-Efficiency-9756
comments.body: Yeah this is amazing. I can’t wait to look through this. wtf nice!

comments.author: humanzookeeping2
comments.body: It would be nice if the LLM could write some JavaScript to conjure new game mechanics. (sandboxed, of course)

replies.author: levmiseri
replies.body: It can do that! It’s heavily sandboxed, but try describing some brief yet complex behavior of whatever object you want in the game and LLM has a way of writing custom code for it
